what_happened: Cell-level refutation of ForwardSlackWitnessed at a large amount compiled on the first full pass: specs/929_.../evidence/i-one-ceiling.lean, standard axioms only.

Task 929's stated goal (discharge I=1 so ForwardSlackWitnessed becomes unconditional) is refuted, not dischargeable: compiled cell-level refutation at amount n+c+2 on a no-idle-cycle object. The consumer-relevant instantiation survives; frontier restated rather than closed.

Research report's wiring recommendation 'move the wired total 55 -> 56' is wrong on both counts: check-evidence-probes.sh holds 57 WIRED + 1 WIRED_REPO entries (total 58 -> 59), and no hardcoded total exists to edit because wired_total is computed from array lengths at line 2692. Plan supersedes the recommendation and schedules no numeric edit.

LadderChain.lean sits 43 lines below a longFile re-tightening boundary: 2956 lines against a declared baseline 3000, where the linter accepts only {candidate-100, candidate} and candidate jumps 3100 -> 3200 at 3000 lines. A docstring-only phase adding 44+ lines would fail CI under --wfail. Scheduled as named phase work in Phase 3 rather than left to be discovered.

Carried-figure re-validation caught the dispatch description's load-bearing premise ('closing I=1 is dischargeable on the pumpable side rather than refuted') as falsified by this task's own research before any plan construction, so the plan was built on the refutation disposition rather than on a discharge attempt.

Phase 1's Scope Hypothesis was confirmed exactly on both halves: check-evidence-probes.sh reported 'PASS all 59 wired probe(s) compile' (58 -> 59), and no hardcoded probe total exists anywhere in scripts/ or docs/ (grep returned nothing); wired_total is computed from the two array lengths at check-evidence-probes.sh:2768 (pre-edit 2692, exactly the line the plan cited). No numeric edit was needed.

Plan Phase 1 names pin-cascade-straddle.lean and route-space-closure.lean as both carrying the four-line Apache copyright header; only route-space-closure.lean does (pin-cascade-straddle.lean starts directly with its import). The header was added to the promoted probe per the plan's instruction, matching route-space-closure.lean's shape. No action changed, only the plan's parenthetical is inaccurate.

Foreign untracked directory specs/evidence/history-morphism-saturation-audit/ (two .lean probes) observed in the working tree, not created by this dispatch and not in this plan's file scope. Left untouched and not staged; explicit-file-list staging only. Most likely sibling task 930's in-flight work. git log shows no foreign commits beyond the two sibling plan/research commits.

Transcribing the evidence probe verbatim into the library tripped linter.style.show at LadderIdle.lean:1199 (next_pend_of_idle). The probe compiles clean under check-evidence-probes.sh's 'lake env lean' invocation, which does not apply the library's lint option set; the library build with --wfail treats it as a failure. Fixed by one token: show -> change. Lesson: a probe that compiles standalone is not thereby library-lint-clean.

Phase 2 landed with zero proof-level rework: all sixteen declarations elaborated unchanged inside the library namespace on first build, and the five headline axiom profiles matched the plan's predicted values exactly ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] for four, [propext, Quot.sound] for ceiling_slack_at_consumer_amount). The plan's up-front confirmation that ClimbWitness reaches LadderIdle via LadderChain meant no import line was needed and check-metalogic-cycles Assertion B stayed untouched.

Phase 3's grep criterion (no 'dischargeable on the pumpable side' anywhere under RaySummary/) could not pass without also touching Phase 2's landed section IOne docstring, which quoted that wording verbatim to falsify it. Rephrased both the quotation and my own LadderChain wording; no claim changed. Second-order win: the original phrasing was also record-versioning language barred in deliverables.

LadderChain line-count risk (43-line headroom to the declared longFile 3000) did not bind: the two docstring edits added 28 lines, landing at 2984, so no longFile re-tightening was needed. Guarded build of all three edited modules was green on the first attempt with zero errors and zero warnings.

Phase 4 Scope Hypothesis predicted four README inventory blocks would move; only three did. FormalSystem/README.md (dir=FormalSystem rows=loose) came back byte-identical because its block ranges over loose files directly under FormalSystem/, none of which this plan touched. typst/generated/status.typ likewise needed no change: typst-sync-check.sh --fix was a no-op because Phase 3 already settled it. No block outside the predicted list changed.

Plan Phase 4 expected check-paper-definitions.sh to report SKIP (neutral) because 'the paper's repository is not visible here'. It IS visible on this machine (/home/benjamin/Philosophy/Papers/PossibleWorlds/JPL/possible_worlds.tex) and the gate exits 1 on 9 drifted definition anchors. All drift is LaTeX list/spacing formatting in an external repository; this plan touched no .tex and no docs/reference file, so the finding is causally impossible to attribute here and is recorded as pre-existing and out of scope.

Last touched by an unrelated earlier task; zero occurrences in task 929's commit range. Recorded as pre-existing and out of scope rather than fixed, per the plan's contingency clause.

Regeneration plus the hand-written description closed both in one pass, so the module's conditional discharge and the I = 1 refutation now both have a README surface where neither had one.
